title: Algorithms
description: A recipe precise enough for a machine. Some take steps in proportion to the input, some its square: sorting a million things can take twenty million steps, or a trillion.

puzzle.goal: A good sort of n things compares them about n·log₂ n times. Write that count M.
puzzle.name: Comparison sort
puzzle.method: There are n! orders, and each comparison halves the choices: log₂(n!) ≈ n log₂ n of them.
